description: Get FedEx rate quotes for a shipment between two zip codes, optionally filtered by service type.

weight_lb.description: Package weight in pounds; used to scale the quoted charge (default 1.0).

service_type.description: Optional FedEx service type to filter the quotes by (e.g. FEDEX_GROUND).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds rateReplyDetails and quoteDate; on failure (no matching rates), output contains an error message.

description: Create a FedEx shipment (label) and register its initial tracking record.

service_type.description: The FedEx service type for the shipment (default FEDEX_GROUND).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds transactionShipments with the new tracking number and label document; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Track a FedEx shipment by its tracking number.

tracking_number.description: The FedEx tracking number to look up.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds completeTrackResults with the latest status and scan events; on failure (tracking number not found), output contains an error message.
